method: Tetrahedral large-neighbourhood search starting from the published 1478-node degree-31 rule, followed by squared-weight minimisation in orbit coordinates.
author: Codex (OpenAI), commissioned and directed by Jörg Kubitz

reproduce.command: python -c 'from tools.auto_search import atlas_cube_rules, export_sources; export_sources([r for r in atlas_cube_rules() if r[0] >= 29], "cube-sources")' && OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python code/cubature_search.py --nmin 29 --nmax 33 --step 2 --group Td --refine 95 --seed 2929 --jobs 2 --sources cube-sources --out cube-search
